about: Which photograph fills each photo position of the mock-ups: position -> file name in mockups/photos/, a folder git IGNORES. ⛔ No photograph is committed: this repository is public and a photo's usage rights are the Owner's. There are nine positions, one per place: each is used by exactly one place in one piece (the README lists where), so a photo shows only where it is chosen for, and a repeat is its chooser's choice. A position whose file is not in the folder shows a labelled placeholder. To preview with real photos, copy a photo into mockups/photos/ under its position's file name (e.g. tent-large.jpg) and run `npm run build:mockups`; this manifest is not edited, and never names a photo's own name or ID.
status_note: PLACEHOLDER file names, each its position's own, and they stay so: a chosen photo is copied under its position's file name in mockups/photos/, never named here (SPEC-mockup-photos.md § 1, 2026-09-30).
